versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν διδάσκοντος αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εὐαγγελιζομένου ἐπέστησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς σὺν τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις,

controles.web: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
controles.livre: E aconteceu, num daqueles dias que, enquanto ele estava ensinando ao povo no Templo, e anunciando o Evangelho, vieram até ele os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas com os anciãos.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπαν λέγοντες πρὸς αὐτόν Εἰπὸν ἡμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, ἢ τίς ἐστιν ὁ δούς σοι τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην;

controles.web: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
controles.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
controles.livre: E falaram-lhe, dizendo: Dize-nos, com que autoridade fazes estas coisas? Ou quem é o que te deu esta autoridade?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον, καὶ εἴπατέ μοι

controles.web: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
controles.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
controles.livre: E respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Também eu vos perguntarei algo, e dizei-me:

versos.grego: Τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάνου ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἦν ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων;

controles.web: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
controles.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
controles.livre: O batismo de João era do céu, ou dos homens?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ συνελογίσαντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντες ὅτι Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ Διὰ τί οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

controles.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
controles.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
controles.livre: E eles discutiam entre si, dizendo: Se dissermos: Do céu, ele nos dirá: Por que, então, vós não o crestes?

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, ὁ λαὸς ἅπας καταλιθάσει ἡμᾶς· πεπεισμένος γάρ ἐστιν Ἰωάνην προφήτην εἶναι.

controles.web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
controles.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
controles.livre: E se dissermos: Dos homens, todo o povo nos apedrejará; pois estão convencidos de que João era profeta.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν μὴ εἰδέναι πόθεν.

controles.web: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
controles.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
controles.livre: E responderam que não sabiam de onde era .

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse: Nem eu vos direi com que autoridade eu faço estas coisas.

versos.grego: Ἤρξατο δὲ πρὸς τὸν λαὸν λέγειν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην. ἄνθρωπος ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν χρόνους ἱκανούς.

controles.web: He began to tell the people this parable. “A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
controles.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
controles.livre: E começou a dizer ao povo esta parábola: Um certo homem plantou uma vinha, e a arrendou a uns lavradores, e viajou para outro país por muito tempo.

versos.grego: καὶ καιρῷ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς δοῦλον, ἵνα ἀπὸ τοῦ καρποῦ τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος δώσουσιν αὐτῷ· οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν δείραντες κενόν.

controles.web: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.
controles.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
controles.livre: E certo tempo depois mandou um servo aos lavradores, para que lhe dessem do fruto da vinha; mas os lavradores, espancando-o, mandaram -no sem coisa alguma.

versos.grego: καὶ προσέθετο ἕτερον πέμψαι δοῦλον· οἱ δὲ κἀκεῖνον δείραντες καὶ ἀτιμάσαντες ἐξαπέστειλαν κενόν.

controles.web: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
controles.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
controles.livre: E voltou a mandar outro servo; mas eles, espancando e humilhando também a ele ,o mandaram sem nada.

versos.grego: καὶ προσέθετο τρίτον πέμψαι· οἱ δὲ καὶ τοῦτον τραυματίσαντες ἐξέβαλον.

controles.web: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
controles.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
controles.livre: E voltou a mandar ao terceiro; mas eles, ferindo também a este, o expulsaram.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος Τί ποιήσω; πέμψω τὸν υἱόν μου τὸν ἀγαπητόν· ἴσως τοῦτον ἐντραπήσονται.

controles.web: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
controles.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
controles.livre: E o senhor da vinha disse: Que farei? Mandarei a meu filho amado; talvez quando o verem, o respeitarão.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ γεωργοὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν, ἵνα ἡμῶν γένηται ἡ κληρονομία.

controles.web: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
controles.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
controles.livre: Mas os lavradores, vendo-o, discutiram entre si, dizendo: Este é o herdeiro; vamos matá-lo, para que a herança venha a ser nossa.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος ἀπέκτειναν. τί οὖν ποιήσει αὐτοῖς ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος;

controles.web: They threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
controles.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
controles.livre: E expulsando-o da vinha, o mataram. O que, então, lhes fará o senhor da vinha?

versos.grego: ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τοὺς γεωργοὺς τούτους, καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις. ἀκούσαντες δὲ εἶπαν Μὴ γένοιτο.

controles.web: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.”   When they heard it, they said, “May it never be!”
controles.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
controles.livre: Virá, e destruirá a estes lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.E eles, ouvindo isto, disseram: Que isto nunca aconteça!

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς εἶπεν Τί οὖν ἐστιν τὸ γεγραμμένον τοῦτο Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας;

controles.web: But he looked at them, and said, “Then what is this that is written,  ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?’
controles.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
controles.livre: Mas Jesus ,olhando para eles, disse: Por que, então, isto está escrito: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa foi posta como a principal da esquina?

versos.grego: πᾶς ὁ πεσὼν ἐπ’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν λίθον συνθλασθήσεται· ἐφ’ ὃν δ’ ἂν πέσῃ, λικμήσει αὐτόν.

controles.web: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces,  but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
controles.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
controles.livre: Todo aquele que cair sobre aquela pedra, se quebrará em pedaços; e aquele sobre quem ela cair, se fará pó.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐζήτησαν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐπιβαλεῖν ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν λαόν· ἔγνωσαν γὰρ ὅτι πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην.

controles.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
controles.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
controles.livre: E os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas queriam detê-lo naquela mesma hora, mas temiam ao povo; porque entenderam que foi contra eles que ele tinha dito a parábola.

versos.grego: Καὶ παρατηρήσαντες ἀπέστειλαν ἐνκαθέτους ὑποκρινομένους ἑαυτοὺς δικαίους εἶναι, ἵνα ἐπιλάβωνται αὐτοῦ λόγου, ὥστε παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν τῇ ἀρχῇ καὶ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος.

controles.web: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
controles.kjv: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
controles.livre: E, observando-o, mandaram espiões, que fingissem ser justos, para o pegarem por meio de algo que ele dissesse, e o entregarem ao poder e autoridade do governador.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὀρθῶς λέγεις καὶ διδάσκεις καὶ οὐ λαμβάνεις πρόσωπον, ἀλλ’ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ διδάσκεις·

controles.web: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
controles.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
controles.livre: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, nós sabemos que falas e ensinas corretamente, e que não te importas com as aparências, mas na verdade tu ensinas o caminho de Deus.

versos.grego: ἔξεστιν ἡμᾶς Καίσαρι φόρον δοῦναι ἢ οὔ;

controles.web: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
controles.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cesar, or no?
controles.livre: É lícito para nós dar tributo a César, ou não?

versos.grego: κατανοήσας δὲ αὐτῶν τὴν πανουργίαν εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς

controles.web: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
controles.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
controles.livre: E ele, entendendo a astúcia deles, disse-lhes:

versos.grego: Δείξατέ μοι δηνάριον· τίνος ἔχει εἰκόνα καὶ ἐπιγραφήν; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Καίσαρος.

controles.web: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?”    They answered, “Caesar’s.”
controles.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cesar’s.
controles.livre: Mostrai-me uma moeda; ela tem a imagem e a inscrição de quem?E eles, respondendo, disseram: De César.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τοίνυν ἀπόδοτε τὰ Καίσαρος Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cesar the things which be Cesar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.
controles.livre: Então lhes disse: Dai pois a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἐπιλαβέσθαι αὐτοῦ ῥήματος ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ θαυμάσαντες ἐπὶ τῇ ἀποκρίσει αὐτοῦ ἐσίγησαν.

controles.web: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.
controles.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
controles.livre: E não puderam lhe pegar em algo que ele tenha dito diante do povo; e maravilhados de sua resposta, calaram-se.

versos.grego: Προσελθόντες δέ τινες τῶν Σαδδουκαίων, οἱ ἀντιλέγοντες ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι, ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν

controles.web: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
controles.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
controles.livre: E chegando-se alguns dos saduceus, que negam haver a ressurreição, perguntaram-lhe,

versos.grego: λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν, ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ ἔχων γυναῖκα, καὶ οὗτος ἄτεκνος ᾖ, ἵνα λάβῃ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.
controles.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
controles.livre: Dizendo: Mestre, Moisés nos escreveu, que se o irmão de alguém morrer, tendo mulher, e morrer sem filhos, o irmão deve tomar a mulher, e gerar descendência a seu irmão.

versos.grego: ἑπτὰ οὖν ἀδελφοὶ ἦσαν· καὶ ὁ πρῶτος λαβὼν γυναῖκα ἀπέθανεν ἄτεκνος·

controles.web: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
controles.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
controles.livre: Houve, pois, sete irmãos, e o primeiro tomou mulher, e morreu sem filhos.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος

controles.web: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
controles.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
controles.livre: E o segundo,

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν, ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ οὐ κατέλιπον τέκνα καὶ ἀπέθανον.

controles.web: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
controles.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
controles.livre: E o terceiro a tomou, e assim também os sete, e não deixaram filhos, e morreram.

versos.grego: ὕστερον καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: Afterward the woman also died.
controles.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.
controles.livre: E por fim, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.

versos.grego: ἡ γυνὴ οὖν ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τίνος αὐτῶν γίνεται γυνή; οἱ γὰρ ἑπτὰ ἔσχον αὐτὴν γυναῖκα.

controles.web: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
controles.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
controles.livre: Na ressurreição, pois, ela será mulher de qual deles? Pois os sete a tiveram por mulher.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου γαμοῦσιν καὶ γαμίσκονται,

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
controles.livre: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Os filhos destes tempos se casam, e se dão em casamento.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ καταξιωθέντες τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐκείνου τυχεῖν καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τῆς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται·

controles.web: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.
controles.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
controles.livre: Mas os que forem considerados dignos de alcançarem aqueles tempos futuros, e da ressurreição dos mortos, nem se casarão, nem se darão em casamento.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀποθανεῖν ἔτι δύνανται, ἰσάγγελοι γάρ εἰσιν, καὶ υἱοί εἰσιν Θεοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως υἱοὶ ὄντες.

controles.web: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
controles.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
controles.livre: Porque já não podem mais morrer; pois são iguais aos anjos; e são filhos de Deus, pois são filhos da ressurreição.

versos.grego: ὅτι δὲ ἐγείρονται οἱ νεκροὶ, καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐμήνυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς Βάτου, ὡς λέγει Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Θεὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Θεὸν Ἰακώβ·

controles.web: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
controles.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
controles.livre: E até Moisés mostrou, junto à sarça, que os mortos ressuscitam, quando ele chama ao Senhor de Deus de Abraão, e Deus de Isaque, e Deus de Jacó.

versos.grego: Θεὸς δὲ οὐκ ἔστιν νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων· πάντες γὰρ αὐτῷ ζῶσιν.

controles.web: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
controles.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
controles.livre: Ora, ele não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos; pois todos vivem por causa dele.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθέντες δέ τινες τῶν γραμματέων εἶπαν Διδάσκαλε, καλῶς εἶπας.

controles.web: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
controles.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
controles.livre: E alguns dos escribas, respondendo, disseram: Mestre, bem disseste.

versos.grego: οὐκέτι γὰρ ἐτόλμων ἐπερωτᾶν αὐτὸν οὐδέν.

controles.web: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
controles.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
controles.livre: E não ousavam lhe perguntar mais nada.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Πῶς λέγουσιν τὸν Χριστὸν εἶναι Δαυεὶδ υἱόν;

controles.web: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Como dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?

versos.grego: αὐτὸς γὰρ Δαυεὶδ λέγει ἐν βίβλῳ ψαλμῶν Εἶπεν Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου

controles.web: David himself says in the book of Psalms,  ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
controles.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
controles.livre: Pois o próprio Davi diz no livro dos Salmos: Disse o Senhor a meu Senhor: Senta-te à minha direita,

versos.grego: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

controles.web: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
controles.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
controles.livre: Até que eu ponha teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.

versos.grego: Δαυεὶδ οὖν αὐτὸν Κύριον καλεῖ, καὶ πῶς αὐτοῦ υἱός ἐστιν;

controles.web: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
controles.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
controles.livre: Se Davi o chama de Senhor, como, então, é seu filho?

versos.grego: Ἀκούοντος δὲ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς

controles.web: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
controles.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
controles.livre: Enquanto todo o povo estava ouvindo, ele disse a seus discípulos:

versos.grego: Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων περιπατεῖν ἐν στολαῖς καὶ φιλούντων ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις,

controles.web: “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
controles.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
controles.livre: Tomai cuidado com os escribas, que querem andar roupas compridas, e amam as saudações nas praças, e as primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas, e os primeiros assentos nos jantares.

versos.grego: οἳ κατεσθίουσιν τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ προφάσει μακρὰ προσεύχονται· οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.

controles.web: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.”
controles.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
controles.livre: Que devoram as casas das viúvas, e fingem fazer longas orações. Estes receberão mais grave condenação.
